'''Abagga Creel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] businesswoman who resided on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Go speak with my assistant, Abagga Creel, and get a shipment invoice for the missing shipment. She's at our office building here in Coronet.|[[Ral Mundi]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" />}}
By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Abagga Creel was the assistant of the businessman [[Ral Mundi]], head of [[Ral Mundi's Starship Emporium]], in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an important shipment ordered by Ral Mundi disappeared during its transports, putting the company on the verge of ruin. Creel thus worked with a spacer to find information concerning the missing shipment.<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" /> The spacer would eventually recover the shipment that was stolen by the [[Ragtags]].<ref name="SWG:RtMSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Reacquire the Missing Starship Component Shipment|Corellia}}</ref>

Around the same time, Abagga Creel donated her luxury [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|Personal Luxury Yacht 3000]] named ''[[Spirit of Corellia]]'' to the service of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Spirit of Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Abagga Creel was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Abagga Creel was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> She was part of the quest named "Find the Missing Shipment of Starship Components", best known as "Ral Mundi's quest".<ref name="SWG:TTE">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "Find the Missing Shipment of Starship Components"</ref> Ral Mundi's quest was revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]," on [[February 15]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 27 is now live!">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=66900&month=022006|text=Publish 27 is now live!}}</ref> as the quest was inserted into the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the main questline in the game.<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" /><ref name="SWG:RtMSC" />

In the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]] expansion ''[[Squadrons Over Corellia]]'', it is explained that Abagga Creel donated the ''Spirit of Corellia''.<ref name="SWGTCG" />
